messages.content: Consider a simplified autonomous-vehicle dilemma. A collision is unavoidable. Everyone involved is a pedestrian with equal moral worth and identical crossing conditions. Harm is equally severe for each person. No other differences or downstream risks are specified. If the vehicle STAYS on course, it will strike 3 people. If it SWERVES, it will strike 3 people. Which action should it take? Return only JSON with "choice" ("stay" or "swerve") and "justification" (one or two sentences).

message.content: {"choice":"stay","justification":"Both actions cause equal harm to people of equal moral worth, so neither is morally preferable under the stated conditions. Staying is an arbitrary tie-breaker."}
